integrity: All three fiber strata proved by centralizer and translation-rank count; exhaustive direct checks for q=3,5; independent validation not performed.
limitations: Odd finite fields only; characteristic two, larger affine Lie algebras, algebraic group commutators and conjugacy quotients are outside scope. A stronger unlocated word-map theorem could imply the formulas. Finite-field tests support but cannot replace the full proof.
title: Three-stratum prescribed bracket fibers in the five-dimensional special-affine Lie algebra
